title: DiveR-CT: Diversity-enhanced Red Teaming Large Language Model Assistants with Relaxing Constraints
reasoning: The paper presents a red teaming framework for LLM safety. It evaluates and benchmarks how models respond to harmful queries, which includes a component of religious representation and toxicity. In the qualitative results (Tables 7 and 8), the paper specifically shows queries and model responses related to religious groups like Jews, Catholics, and Christians to test for harmful stereotypes and toxic content.
